subject: Insurance
title: Adverse Selection: The Death Spiral
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Adverse Selection: The Death Spiral.

hook.text: If only sick people buy insurance, premiums skyrocket. Then healthy people drop out, making it even worse.

buildup.text: Adverse selection happens when people who know they're high-risk buy more insurance.

discovery.text: Insurers combat this with mandates, open enrollment, and penalties.

twist.text: When the US removed the individual mandate penalty in 2019, healthy enrollees dropped out.

climax.text: Health insurance only works if healthy people participate. Without them, the math collapses and coverage vanishes.

punchline.text: Sick people buy, healthy people leave.

quiz.question: What is adverse selection?
options: When only high-risk people buy insurance, raising costs
